resolutions.note: applied-v3 names Executive Order 10804 section 2 (revokes parent EO 9721 with exceptions, does not name EO 9949) in the rationale and earlier-end check.
The held text reads 'Rail-' at a line end and 'road Company' on the next line (soft hyphen), so the word railroad is present in the order heading and recital; the ampersand is OCR'd as 'ty'.

The order body contains the section 10 sentence 'from this date and for thirty days after the board has made its report ... no change, except by agreement, shall be made'; 'standstill' is the claim's plain label for that sentence, and OCR noise ('changé') defeats the matcher.
